data.itinerary:
### Day 1: Arrival and Exploring South Bali
Arrive in Bali and pick up your rental car at the airport. Start your day by visiting the famous Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff overlooking the Indian Ocean. Watch the traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at sunset. After the show, head to Jimbaran Bay for a seafood dinner on the beach.

### Day 2: Central Bali Adventure
Drive to the town of Ubud, known for its artistic and cultural scene. Visit the Ubud Monkey Forest, a nature reserve and Hindu temple complex. Next, explore the Ubud Art Market, where you can find local handicrafts and souvenirs. In the afternoon, visit the Tegalalang Rice Terrace, a beautiful landscape of rice fields and valleys.

### Day 3: North Bali Exploration
Drive to the north coast of Bali, visiting the beautiful town of Lovina, known for its black sand beaches and dolphin watching opportunities. Stop at the Banjar Hot Springs, a natural hot spring resort surrounded by lush gardens. On your way back to the airport, visit the famous Tanah Lot Temple, a scenic rock formation with a temple perched on top.

Since there are no transport products available, I will recommend a tour that includes transportation.

recommendedProducts.name: Sunrise Trekking Mount Batur
recommendedProducts.description: Daki Gunung Batur (1.717 mdpl) di tengah malam dan saksikan matahari terbit paling dramatis di Bali dari puncak kawah aktif. Pemandangan Danau Batur dan Gunung Agung akan menemani langkah Anda.

recommendedProducts.name: Ubud Wellness Retreat – Yoga, Spa & Rice Field Walk
recommendedProducts.description: Mulai pagi dengan yoga sunrise di sawah Tegallalang, dilanjutkan walk meditasi di jalan setapak persawahan, dan diakhiri dengan traditional Balinese massage 2 jam di spa premium Ubud.

recommendedProducts.name: Goa Jomblang Vertical Cave & Kalisuci Cave Tubing
recommendedProducts.description: Dua petualangan goa dalam satu hari: rappelling turun 60 meter ke Goa Jomblang untuk menyaksikan cahaya surga (heaven light) di hutan purba dalam gua, lalu cave tubing menyusuri sungai bawah tanah Kalisuci yang dingin.
recommendedProducts.location: Semanu, Kabupaten Gunungkidul, DI Yogyakarta, Indonesia
